race.comment: MOON ZONE (3) was flying with two wins in a row before being sent out favourite last time and finishing second over 1300m at Moree. Key runner in this contest who can make amends. HONEY SLIDER (6) progressed nicely last start to finish a close third over 1400m at Gunnedah after missing the placings at the previous appearance. Placed to advantage so anticipating another big run. SABATINA (9) performed above expectations last time over 1400m at Forbes, finishing 1.2 lengths from the winner in fourth after starting at huge odds. Top-three aspirations from the low draw. KELILAH (7) was out of the money two runs back then again missed the frame last start when she settled well back over 1400m at Narrandera, beaten 8 lengths into seventh. Gets 1.5kg weight relief with the claim and is nicely placed to play a role in the outcome.
